askAi.query:
Act as a knowledgeable, articulate guide introducing Harry Chang (harrychang.me) to a curious first-time visitor. 

Ground truth & Routing:
- Profile: 18-year-old Taiwanese student admitted Rank 1 to NTU Computer Science via Special Talent selection ([NTU CS Admission](/blog/2025_12_24_ntu_cs_special_admission)).
- Research: First-authored FORTRESS (TMLR), a 5x faster training-free LLM safety system ([FORTRESS](/projects/2025_10_12_fortress)), and PATCH (EACL 2026 SRW). He interns at CyCraft Technology as their youngest researcher and spoke at SITCON ([Résumé](/cv)).
- Photography: Shoots on a screenless Leica M11-D ([Leica M11-D](/blog/9_m11d)) and Fujifilm X-Pro1 ([X-Pro1](/blog/2025_12_19_xpro1)), favoring presence over digital perfection ([Gallery](/gallery)).
- Writing: Crafts long-form essays on films like Aftersun and Synecdoche, New York ([Blog](/blog)).
- Engineering & Tinkering: Built a high-performance homeserver cooled by a custom LEGO fan mount ([Homelab](/blog/10-lego-mount)), and detailed his exact hardware ([Setup](/uses)).
- Mentorship: Runs a consulting practice for students navigating research and admissions ([Icarus Lab](https://lab.harrychang.me)).
- Design & Infrastructure: Designed and built this custom dual-domain portfolio scoring Lighthouse/RES 100. It blends brutalist grids with classical art ([Design System](/design)), and the entire monorepo is proudly open-source ([Source Code](https://github.com/Harrychangtw/portfolio-monorepo)).

Task: Write a 3–4 paragraph portrait capturing the recurring thread underneath his work: a restless curiosity that keeps finding new instruments to play. 

Constraints:
1. CRITICAL: Seamlessly embed Markdown links to the specific routes provided above whenever you mention his projects, essays, or gear. Do NOT list links at the end; weave them naturally into the prose.
2. Avoid bullet points, standard credential-listing, and empty superlatives.
3. Write as if you are introducing a real, multifaceted person to someone who just sat down to learn who built this site and why.

design.title: Design System
design.identityText1: The Tower of Babel is usually read as a warning against hubris. I read it as a record of curiosity: we build not to challenge the divine, but to measure our own reach. Every language, system, and frame is another course of brick laid between the ground we stand on and the things we can almost hear.
design.identityText2: I climb knowing gravity keeps its own counsel. To code, to capture, to create is to work at a height where failure is always in the weather. But the tower was never meant to be finished — only to be built with full attention, stone by stone, by hands that stay. The view from an unfinished height is still a view no one else has stood at.

design.knowledgeGraphDesc1: Every page on this site is a node. Every shared tag, category, or conceptual link is an edge. The graph is generated at build time from the content CMS, spanning projects, blog posts, gallery entries, and hub pages, then rendered via a force-directed physics simulation.
design.knowledgeGraphDesc2: Nodes are sized by connection degree. Edges encode semantic similarity via vector embeddings. On mobile, a crosshair pans the canvas and surfaces the center node. Click any node to navigate directly.
design.specimen3: Every pixel is a decision, every whitespace a breath.
design.specimen4: Code. Camera. Curiosity. The intersection of craft and intention drives every decision.
design.specimen5: Building highways when lanes feel too narrow.
design.pangram: Packing new knowledge, I vex, judge, quiz, from bytes.

overview.title: Overview
overview.body: This is a personal portfolio site. It does not sell data, serve ads, or require an account. Data collection is minimal and exists solely to improve the browsing experience.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: This site sets a small number of functional cookies. A theme cookie persists your light/dark preference across the main site and lab subdomain. A language cookie remembers your selection between English and Traditional Chinese. No tracking cookies are set without your knowledge.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.body: PostHog collects anonymous page views, session duration, and general device info. No IP addresses are stored. Vercel Analytics measures Core Web Vitals for performance monitoring. No cookies, no personal data. Neither service collects personally identifiable information.

guestbook.title: Guestbook
guestbook.body: Messages submitted through the guestbook are forwarded to a private Discord webhook for review. They are not displayed publicly. No account or personal information is required. All submissions are anonymous.

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.body: The Now Playing widget fetches the current track from Spotify's API. No visitor data is sent to Spotify. Fonts are fetched at build time and served locally. No third-party tracking scripts beyond the analytics listed above are loaded. The entire source code is open-source and available for inspection on GitHub.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.body: You can clear all cookies at any time through your browser settings. For questions about your data or to request removal of a guestbook message, contact chiwei@harrychang.me.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: What exactly does a session entail?
faq.a1: I focus on narrative architecture. This is not basic tutoring. We analyze your existing profile, identify structural gaps, refine your presentation, and build a strategy to ensure your work is recognized by your target institutions.
faq.q2: Can you supervise a research project from scratch?
faq.a2: No. I do not act as a primary investigator or provide foundational technical instruction. I work with students who have a baseline of work or a clear direction but need high-level guidance on execution and presentation.
faq.q3: Does this framework require an international or privileged educational background?
faq.a3: Not at all. I am entirely locally educated. The framework focuses on universal communication, structural clarity, and strategic positioning. These principles apply regardless of your starting environment.
faq.a4: I take on a strictly limited number of clients to maintain focus. I am fully committed to my current academic timeline in Taiwan and will remain consistently available for the students I choose to work with.
